title: 分析师：国内大模型竞争白热化，Jirupu难有持续优势
speaker: Anthony Stephens

segments.en: So, this was, again, the 5.2 model made some headlines. If you look at that model now, it's ranked 27th in the global rankings.
segments.zh: 5.2模型当时引发关注，但如今在全球排名中已跌至第27位。

segments.en: And, as Anthony said, you've got so many model launches, almost every other day at the moment, companies continually leapfrogging each other.
segments.zh: 正如Anthony所言，目前几乎每隔一天就有新模型发布，各公司不断超越彼此。

segments.en: It's very, very hard for all players, not just Jirupu, to gain a sustainable competitive edge.
segments.zh: 对所有参与者而言，不仅是Jirupu，要获得可持续的竞争优势都非常困难。

segments.en: In a market when a China context is commoditized, you've got nearly 1,000 large language models competing against each other in China.
segments.zh: 在竞争同质化的市场环境中，国内有近千个大语言模型在相互竞争。

segments.en: So, we need to see a shake out, we need to see price rises,
segments.zh: 因此，行业需要洗牌，需要价格回升。
